title: Comix Zone

widgets.text: Sketch Turner's health bar is the top-left meter; tearing paper or hitting objects also costs health. Lives = continues.
Bosses are drawn in by Mortus: block, then punish after their combo. Use the iced tea item if health is low.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Episode 1: Night of the Mutants; Episode 2: Welcome to Hell; Episode 3: Curse of the Kung-Fung Masters - each two pages of comic panels.
Two endings depending on whether Alissa is saved in the last page.
Paths split at panel borders: choose the panel arrows to pick a route.

notes: RAM search 2026-10-25, page 1: 0x02005768 starts at 50 and drops 50 -> 48 -> 46 -> 44 -> 42 as Sketch takes hits, back to 50 on the next page. Its match with the on-screen bar (which also shows enemy health) is not confirmed, hence unverified.
